plan.objective: Determine whether the causally active anchored-v3 rank model recovers after its 2k identity dip, and preserve the complete trajectory through a 40k ceiling so the best intermediate checkpoint can be selected.

overnight_design.reason_not_chained: The same run already saves full optimizer and weights checkpoints and performs fixed-96 validation every 2k. Chaining duplicate initializations would add validation overhead and split a directly comparable trajectory across Comet keys.
overnight_design.checkpoint_selection: Select the best validated intermediate checkpoint; do not assume the 40k endpoint is best.

fixed_controls.validation: manual_val full96 at step 0 and every 2000 steps through 40000

interpretation_gates.step_2000: Reproduce E4 within expected run variance; this is not a terminal quality gate.
interpretation_gates.step_8000: First promotion decision: require recovery from the 2k identity trough, a stable weak-face tail, positive reference causality, and coherent images.
interpretation_gates.steps_10000_to_20000: Likely useful selection window based on historical BA peaks; retain every checkpoint and compare matched fixed-96 metrics and images.
interpretation_gates.steps_22000_to_40000: Plateau/overtraining observation window. Continued training must not change which earlier checkpoint is retained as the candidate model.
interpretation_gates.automatic_abort_only: Runtime failure, non-finite loss, OOM, integrity failure, or missing checkpoint/validation artifacts. Visual and aggregate promotion remains a post-run decision.

runtime.startup_state: Exact trainable and optimizer contracts passed; fixed-96 step-zero validation started on RealVisXL.
